selection.rule: Tracked projects whose own record has coordinates with at least 3 decimals (about 100 m), not shared with another project and not the centre of a watched development area; Sumba excluded (independence policy).

source.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A via Element84 Earth Search (STAC) and the Sentinel-2 COGs on AWS Open Data
source.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data are free and open (Copernicus data and information policy, EU Regulation 1159/2013).
source.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2017-2026, processed by Kolaboro

method: Per project, a 150 m circle around the pin from our project record. Per month, up to 2 scenes from one Sentinel-2 tile that see at least 90% of the circle without cloud (Sentinel-2 scene classification: cloud, cirrus, cloud shadow, dark, unclassified and snow pixels removed), per-pixel median. b: share of the circle that looks built-up or bare (NDBI > 0 and NDVI < 0.25). r: the same share in a ring 300 to 600 m from the pin. Change index shown on the project pages: (b - r) minus the median of (b - r) over the first 3 clear months, in percentage points; season and haze move circle and ring together, so the difference is steadier than either share (single-month deviation in the first months: median 4, 90th percentile 15 points, so 15 points either way is shown as normal variation). x: share of the circle whose pixels differ visibly from the first clear month (brightness moved by more than 25 of 255, or a switch between built-up/bare and not with NDBI moving more than 0.1, after subtracting the median shift of the ring); kept for reference, noisier. The series starts in January 2017, the first month of the Sentinel-2 L2A archive on Earth Search; months without a clear scene are left empty, never filled in. Thumbnails: true colour, 640 m square, one linear stretch per project; the white circle is the 150 m analysis circle.
limits: Sentinel-2 pixels are 10 m. They show cleared ground, slabs, roofs and large cranes, not floors, interiors or quality of work: a tower going up on a plot that was already concrete changes little, and a finished building should look unchanged. Season, low winter sun (longer shadows), haze and wet ground also move the index. Cloudy months are empty. The pin comes from public sources and is about 100 m accurate, so the circle can miss part of a large site or include a neighbour. This is a prompt to ask the developer for dated site photos, not proof of progress or of a stop.
images: /k/sat/proj/<id>.jpg?v=<v>: one 96 x 96 px tile per clear month, in month order; f[i] is the tile index of month i (-1: no clear scene).

fields.c: share of the circle seen clear, % (null: no clear scene)
fields.b: built-up or bare share of the circle, %
fields.r: built-up or bare share of the 300-600 m ring, %
fields.x: share of the circle differing visibly from the first clear month, % (reference, noisier)
fields.dt: date of the first scene used
fields.sum: medians of the first and last 3 clear months
fields.search_gaps: months whose archive search failed (left empty)
